Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Lucknow And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Anand Singh Pawar,Ramesh Singh
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J.
1. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Sri Yogendra Nath Verma, learned
Standing Counsel appearing for the State.
2. Present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed seeking a writ of
mandamus commanding the respondents to open the sealed cover envelop of the petitioner and
consider him giving adhoc promotion on the post of Inspector for which the D.P.C. was concluded
on 06.05.2022 but petitioner's case was kept in a sealed cover on the ground that the petitioner was
facing a criminal case registered at Case Crime No.245 of 2012 under Sections 498A, 323, 506 Ipc,
3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Kotwali Dehat, Distirct Etah in which charge-sheet had
been filed, however, final decision in the case has not been rendered by the trial court till date.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Petitioner's case for promotion, therefore, was kept in sealed cover on 06.05.2022 in pursuance to the para 10 of the Government Order dated 28.05.1997, which provides that if the decision on the criminal case does not come within one year, the employee in respect of whom the sealed cover is adopted because of the pendency of the criminal case, would be considered for giving ad hoc promotion after a period of one year from the date of sealed cover procedure adopted in respect of his promotion.
4.
Order dated 28.10.2022 issued by the S.S.P. District Badaun itself would disclose that petitioner's case for giving him ad hoc promotion would be considered after 06.05.2023.

Since petitioner's case for giving him ad hoc promotion pending criminal trial in respect of Case Crime No.245 of 2012 (supra) is still pending, I direct respondent Nos.2 and 3 to take a decision for giving the petitioner ad hoc promotion in pursuance to the Government Order dated 28.05.1997 within a period of four weeks from the date a certified copy of this order along with appropriate application is placed before respondent No.2.
5.
With the aforesaid observation/direction, the petition stands disposed of.
(Dinesh Kumar Singh, J.) Order Date :- 22.5.2023 prateek  Manish Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Lucknow ...
